### After the Victory Comes the Blessing
Author: Rick Warren
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/daily-hope-with-rick-warren/daily-hope-with-rick-warren-march-16-2020.html
Passage: 2 Chronicles 20:27
Points:
- Believers often face messy aftermaths even after God wins a victory for them.
- God desires to help His people discover blessings left behind on the battlefield.
- Judah triumphed because they chose worship over anxiety and let God fight.
- The Lord surpassed their expectations by enriching them both spiritually and materially.
- Trusting God in overwhelming circumstances leads us into our own valley of blessing.

### Valley of Blessing
Author: Brenda Bradford Ottinger
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/-encouragement-for-today-january-6-2020.html
Passage: 2 Chronicles 20:26
Points:
- King Jehoshaphat and his people offered praise before they ever saw the victory.
- God acted ahead of them, causing the hostile armies to destroy themselves.
- The people assembled in the Valley of Blessing to thank God before returning home singing.
- Praise and worship are vital bookends before and after life's battles.
- Centering our hearts on the Lord rather than our troubles invites His divine movement.
